The attackers redirected legitimate DeFi websites to malicious frontends running the Step Drainer wallet drainer. 🔴 12 DeFi domains compromised 🔴 Ethereum, Solana & Aptos ecosystems affected 🔴 Malicious wallet approvals and signatures 🔴 ~$138K in traced EVM losses The scariest part?
